Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study is a clinical case-control and disease-severity comparison. The MS component (nano-LC-MS/MS) was used to identify HNE-modified peptides in pooled plasma samples of HCs vs CAD patients. No exogenous chemical or genetic perturbations were applied; the 'treatment' is the disease state itself.

base_candidates_ranked.reason: The experiment used nano-LC-MS/MS (LTQ-Orbitrap XL) with in-gel digestion and de novo sequencing (PEAKS 7) to identify modified peptides. While quantification of the larger cohort was done via ELISA, the discovery phase used standard DDA-style acquisition.
